base-b.about: rhp as it is, a second bundle (A/A control)

regprops.about: --rhp-lo, --rhp-hi and --rhp-p registered as <number> (inherits: true), so each is worked out once per element

noknobs.about: the chart root no longer sets 24 --rhp-* knobs to initial (page variables could then reach in)

noclip.about: the blocks' clip-path: var(--rhp-clip, none) rule gone (shapes stop working)

nocontainer.about: the chart body is no longer a size container (cq units in slat CSS stop working)

notoward.about: --rhp-toward-end set on the Plot and on backward bars only, not on every forward bar

noradius.about: the Bar's four corner rules gone (square bars)

nocenter.about: bars, ticks, dots and labels centered with auto margins or negative margins instead of translate
